title: Uniform distribution and Hardy fields
relevant_concepts: Hardy-field unique ergodicity on the circle
notes: J. Anal. Math. 62 (1994), 225-240. Circle unique ergodicity for {f(n)} when f is Hardy of polynomial growth and stays logarithmically away from integer polynomials. Applies to {n^{27/8}}; does not apply to {floor(n^{3/2})^{9/4}}, which is not a Hardy function of n. The circle case that Frantzikinakis 2009 generalizes to nilmanifolds. Cited by docs/problems/juggler_v94_rate_free.md and docs/problems/juggler_rate_free_floor_hardy.md.
